item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 31/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the coast of southern China today. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, it will be mainly fine and very hot over Guangdong early next week. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will affect the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. The area of low pressure to the east of the Philippines is expected to develop gradually in the next few days and move towards the vicinity of Luzon. However, there are still uncertainties in its subsequent movement and intensity. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will move towards the vicinity of Honshu of Japan and weaken gradually today and tomorrow.
